entries.current_effect: the attestation states its own scope and unreadable paths
entries.required_work: tools/attest-clean.sh enumerates untracked paths, records the exact commit and tree, and names each inaccessible path explicitly rather than silently scoping it away.
entries.title: Full clean-worktree attestation unavailable
entries.why_blocking: Git cannot stat tracked paths under .kin/** and evidence/**, so untracked or modified material there cannot be excluded.

entries.current_effect: V-10 reports instrument=PASS product=NOT_RUN
entries.required_work: Nodes carry an origin; a selftest-marked node is instrument-only and can never resolve the product channel.
entries.title: V-10 reported product PASS with no product
entries.why_blocking: Two static selftest assertions resolved both channels to PASS.

entries.current_effect: a skipped parameter keeps its function NOT_RUN
entries.required_work: The census folds every collected parameter instance, keeping the worst outcome, and never discards an instance.
entries.title: Parameterised nodes collapsed into one census record
entries.why_blocking: f[codex] skipped and f[claude] passing folded to one key; the later record overwrote the earlier.

entries.current_effect: a loosened clause no longer rejects its own frozen negative, so the ledger reports a survivor
entries.required_work: tests/tools/freeze-controls.py derives the positive, negative and benign controls once and commits them with a digest; rawcontrols.py reads those frozen bytes at run time and never regenerates them, and every row names the executable pre-execution planters bound to its own nodes.
entries.title: Controls and mutations are circular synthetic artifacts
entries.why_blocking: conforming(), violating(), the blinded checker and the judge all derived from one clause object, so the ledger could only restate the clause to itself and could not establish sensitivity to product behaviour.

entries.current_effect: an executed row with no evaluation record makes its gate INVALID_HARNESS
entries.required_work: test_no_green_paths.py rejects any catalog row whose declared node does not literally call its checker for that exact OID, and consumption.py records a content-addressed evaluation per row at run time.
entries.title: Obligations lack executable checker coupling
entries.why_blocking: 66 of 92 obligations were named by a test that never called their checker, so a weak test satisfied the census without consuming its row.

entries.current_effect: all fifteen gate modules report zero findings
entries.required_work: greenpath.py analyses every test function individually for bare return, untyped assert, permissive default, collection fallback, tautology, swallowed failure, unproved loop domain, optional guard and missing catalog consumption.
entries.title: Static green-path audit missed the patterns it forbids
entries.why_blocking: The linter checked three literal defaults and accepted a module if one total-quantifier name appeared anywhere; 24 collection defaults, 17 optional loops and 41 guarded assertion blocks survived it.

entries.current_effect: a mutation changes what the product reads, not what it printed
entries.required_work: planters.py applies all 35 catalogued mutations to raw state at a declared seam before the product starts --- event body and bytes, certificate, external root, published registry, native source, user and service config, corpus record, host envelope, fault schedule --- and records an independent read-back witness.
entries.title: Planters rewrite the result after execution
entries.why_blocking: The interposer ran the real product first and then edited stdout and exit status, mutating observation rather than causal behaviour.

entries.current_effect: a partial or infrastructure failure is not a kill
entries.required_work: mutation-run.sh parses per-node call-phase reports, requires every named node to fail in the planter's declared channel, and rejects a run whose planter never reached its seam.
entries.title: Mutation runner counts infrastructure failure as a kill
entries.why_blocking: Any nonzero pytest status marked the whole mutation KILLED, and the interposer's own configuration was dropped by the driver's env scrub.

entries.current_effect: all six mutations demonstrate escape and gate rejection
entries.required_work: detectorprobe.py plants one positive control per detector mutation on the exact surface it disables; conftest.py rejects V-3 while any detector mutation is active; detector-mutation-run.sh requires both halves per isolated run.
entries.title: Detector mutations never demonstrate gate invalidation
entries.why_blocking: One unit selftest confirmed local blindness; nothing activated a mutation, executed its gate and required INVALID_HARNESS.

entries.current_effect: a missing fixture, right, binary, service or gold record never accuses the product
entries.required_work: prereq.py types every instrument-owned prerequisite and raises HarnessInvalid; gate modules may not contain a bare assert, so a bare AssertionError can only originate in instrument code.
entries.title: Assertion classification conflates instrument and product
entries.why_blocking: Every non-selftest AssertionError became PRODUCT_FAILURE, including assertions about Tester fixture counts and absent prerequisites.

entries.current_effect: V-1 reports the exact ratified table, natively executed
entries.required_work: lifecycle.py declares all 64 ratified cells with their native format, three frozen expected states and a per-cell negative mutation, and executes each transition in the adapter's own source format with before/after raw source digests.
entries.title: V-1 lifecycle matrix is neither exact nor natively executed
entries.why_blocking: The ratified table sums to 64 cells; the catalog required 61. Transitions wrote generic JSON outside the adapter's native source and all cells shared one receipt mutation.

entries.current_effect: V-2 measures the product rather than quoting it
entries.required_work: The excluded 60-message calibration corpus and its manifest are committed and digest bound; metrics.py computes macro-F1, per-label metrics, pooled shared precision, atomisation and abstention in the harness from raw predictions joined to gold on the opaque token; each crash seam is killed at a witnessed artefact and recovery is read back from the store.
entries.title: V-2 lacks calibration, gold-derived metrics and real sagas
entries.why_blocking: The calibration manifest was absent yet a refusal passed; metrics were product-reported; mixed-message lookups used pre-opaque IDs; crash seams were sleep-duration labels with a hardcoded recovery flag.

entries.current_effect: V-3 coverage is executed rather than named
entries.required_work: matrix.py writes native bytes onto each of the twelve declared surfaces across the full surface x encoding cross product and returns an exact receipt per cell; all nineteen threat-model families execute a real probe with control, decoy and detector blinding; the fourteen lifecycle stages are driven through the ratified CLI.
entries.title: V-3 coverage is not total over surfaces and encodings
entries.why_blocking: Family coverage checked anchor names; qualification labelled in-memory payloads with surface names without planting through them; the lifecycle stage list was reported rather than executed.

entries.current_effect: positive controls are worlds a conforming product may admit
entries.required_work: trust.py establishes a live Company, the external root outside the work tree, a steward-signed repository certificate and a published AuthorityRegistry before any fixture is planted, and every gate fixture uses it.
entries.title: Signed worlds lack the ratified external trust prerequisites
entries.why_blocking: SignedWorld wrote a worktree hint and local signers with no external Company root, repository certificate or signed AuthorityRegistry, so a conforming product should have refused the intended positive fixtures.

entries.current_effect: V-4 constructs the state it reports
entries.required_work: Each of the thirteen incremental stages digests the store before and after; the conflict resolves through a real parent-bound event; all four manifest relations are constructed; scale.py builds the 100,000-event ceiling corpus and the 10,000-event dense graph with cross-checked signatures; replay and a two-worktree lock witness are executed.
entries.title: V-4 substitutes labels for transitions, scale, replay and locking
entries.why_blocking: Rebuild and restart marked themselves changed; conflict planted no authorized resolution; three of four manifest relations existed; there was no 10x corpus, no 10,000-event revocation graph, no replay and no lock witness.

entries.current_effect: the product must resolve and use a registered channel
entries.required_work: authority.py runs an independent signed answering process whose key, scope and channel are published through the live registry; delivery is evidenced by the process's own append-only log and the digest of the exact request bytes it received.
entries.title: V-6 has no registered live authority round trip
entries.why_blocking: The fixture never registered the helper key, scope or channel; the test invoked the helper directly, so the product never delivered a question through a registered channel.

entries.current_effect: V-8 ranges over a Company that holds the referenced fact
entries.required_work: Every V-8 fixture installs the certificate and admits the referenced fact plus a superseding version through Company's own admission surface; each cache-table row is constructed by really expiring or revoking state and reading the result back.
entries.title: V-8's live service holds no fact history, cache or revocation
entries.why_blocking: Company started but no referenced fact version was inserted, the certificate was not installed, and cache rows hardcoded state_constructed.

entries.current_effect: V-9 native-event evidence is INVALID_HARNESS until a host delivers its own hooks
entries.required_work: Run each real host non-interactively with Kinbase hooks installed in the isolated HOME and credentials the operator supplies, derive `not_mocked` from dispatcher invocations the host made during that session, and pin the KINBASE_HOST_* versions in a frozen fixture.
entries.title: V-9 performs no approved install or native host invocation
entries.why_blocking: The invocation witness passed on a single `--version` probe of the host: the harness itself sends every native envelope through `hooks dispatch`, so no host ever ran a session or delivered a hook. The earlier closure (real executables behind a recorder, filesystem-digest install comparison, the 250 ms budget, 10,000-event corpora, a real submodule) stands; host-driven delivery was never shown.

entries.current_effect: absence of operator work is INVALID_HARNESS, never a pass
entries.required_work: The blinded operator responses are a typed prerequisite and every one of the twenty decisions is scored and timed by the harness against gold the operator never saw; adequacy sends distinct per-window arrivals and counts slots and admitted facts from the receipts.
entries.title: V-9 permits zero operator work and trusts reported adequacy
entries.why_blocking: The blinded file was never driven; absence of a result passed; adequacy sent the same file five times and trusted product-reported slots.

entries.current_effect: semantic identity no longer reaches the product on any inspected channel
entries.required_work: The policy inspects argv, cwd, stdin, extra_env, base_env overrides and committed paths, and the three named leaks use opaque harness-mapped identifiers.
entries.title: Control inspection incomplete; case identity leaks
entries.why_blocking: The policy read only literal env= keys, missing argv, cwd, stdin, extra_env and committed history; the V-4 scenario, V-8 digest case and V-9 start state crossed those channels.

entries.current_effect: human-grant absence closed; qualification still requires Validator's founder re-attestation over the current digest and Detector Reviewer's signed selection
entries.required_work: Supplied tests/fixtures/auxiliary/GRANT.md, signed Alex Doe of Example Corp at 2026-09-09T20:42:31Z, clauses 1-4, supplies the named rightsholder, asserted VP of Engineering authority, CC0 legal-code digest and both permissions. pool.json records the grant digest as closure evidence; auxsel verifies the reproducible pool. Tester did not author or modify the grant.
entries.title: Auxiliary corpus human rights grant
entries.why_blocking: A Tester assertion of authorship cannot independently prove authority to grant CC0.

entries.current_effect: a missing timeout plugin stops the run
entries.required_work: The suite refuses to start when a declared plugin is missing unless an explicitly recorded untimed run is requested.
entries.title: Reviewer environment did not enforce pytest timeouts
entries.why_blocking: pytest_timeout was unavailable and the strict run still exited zero.
